text.p: Indonesian largest noodle maker PT Indofood Sukses Makmur said on Thursday shareholders had approved Putra Sampoerna, president director of cigarette maker PT Handjaya Mandala Sampoerna, as a commissioner.

"Putra Sampoerna is a reputable figure. He has extensive experience in consumer products. His presence (as a commissioner) would greatly help Indofood's performance," chief executive officer Eva Riyanti Hutapea told reporters after an extraordinary general meeting.
Putra Sampoerna as of March 14 had a stake of around five percent in Indofood.

Putra bought the stake through a cross trade on the Surabaya stock exchange in early March from Indofood's affiliated companies, Eva said. She declined to reveal the current amount of Sampoerna's stake in Indofood or other details.
Putra Sampoerna, who attended Indofood's shareholder meeting, was not available for comment.
Shareholders also approved Indofood's plan to acquire six sister companies in the Salim Group.
